name: NoAmbiente
author: noambiente

sections.description:
NoAmbiente lets your shoppers see flooring, wallpaper, wall panels, paint, rugs, artificial grass and upholstery fabrics applied to a photo of their own room, right on your product page and without leaving your store.

  • The “See it in my room” button appears below “Add to cart”, in the color of your store’s button.
  • The shopper takes or uploads a photo; the simulation is ready in a few seconds, with a before/after slider.
  • The script only acts on product pages. It never runs on the cart, checkout or order pages and does not slow down your site.
  • The store dashboard (app.noambiente.com.br) shows how many shoppers simulated and how they compare with those who did not.

A NoAmbiente account is required (free 10-day trial, no credit card). Plans and conditions: https://noambiente.com.br

Em português: o botão “Ver no meu ambiente” na página de produto. O cliente manda a foto do cômodo e vê o produto aplicado em segundos, sem sair da loja.

External services

This plugin connects to the NoAmbiente service (https://noambiente.com.br), which is required for it to work.

  • On every page of the storefront, the browser loads the script https://noambiente.com.br/v1/noambiente.js with your store key (your store’s domain).
  • On product pages, the script reads the product name, image, category and URL to show the button, and records anonymous usage events (button seen, opened, simulated, clicked to buy) for the store’s dashboard.
  • When the shopper chooses to simulate, the room photo they upload and the product data are sent to NoAmbiente to generate the image. Nothing is sent before the shopper takes this action.
  • If the store enables it, the shopper may choose to leave a name, WhatsApp or e-mail to receive the image.

Terms of use: https://noambiente.com.br/termos
Privacy policy: https://noambiente.com.br/privacidade
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New → search for “NoAmbiente” → Install Now → Activate.
  2. Settings → NoAmbiente: the store key is already filled in with your store address. Click Save.
  3. Create your account at https://app.noambiente.com.br with the same store address and follow the steps in the Installation tab.
  4. Using a cache plugin? Clear the cache.
sections.faq:
Does it work without WooCommerce?

The button is designed for WooCommerce product pages. On other pages the script does nothing.

Which products show the button?

Products that can be applied in a room (floors, walls, rugs, fabrics, grass). You can choose categories and exclude products in the NoAmbiente dashboard.

Does it slow down my store?

No. The script loads asynchronously in the footer and only works on product pages.
